itineraries.title: Outlandish Hillsborough: Highland Games Day
itineraries.theme: Scottish festival, walking tours and an after-dark ghost tour in one walkable town
itineraries.drive_time: About 35 min west of Raleigh via I-40/I-85; 20 min from Durham
itineraries.overview: Hillsborough goes Scottish for its Outlandish weekend. Start at the Saturday farmers market by the river, spend the middle of the day at the Scottish Festival on the grounds of Ayr Mount, walk the town with a guided tour, then finish at the Outlander exhibit and a lantern-lit ghost tour.

morning.location: River Park Farmers Market Pavilion, 144 E Margaret Ln, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: Riverside market on Margaret Ln, a short walk from the Visitors Center.

morning.title: Outlandish Hillsborough Scottish Festival 2026
morning.location: Ayr Mount Historic Site, 376 St. Mary's Rd, Hillsborough, NC, 27278
morning.notes: Runs 10 AM–4 PM on the Ayr Mount grounds, about a 5-minute drive east of downtown. Tickets on the festival page.

afternoon.title: Outlandish Hillsborough Walking Tour
afternoon.location: Hillsborough Visitors Center, 150 E King Street, Hillsborough, NC, 27278
afternoon.notes: Guided walk from the Visitors Center on King St.

afternoon.title: The Outlander Exhibit
afternoon.location: Saltire Gallerie, 209 burnside drive, Hillsborough, NC, 27278
afternoon.notes: Indoor gallery show — the rain-proof stop of the day.

evening.title: Original Historic Ghost Tour
evening.location: Nash and Kollock St., Nash St & Kollock St, Hillsborough, NC
evening.notes: Starts at Nash & Kollock St after dinner; wear shoes for uneven sidewalks.

food.vegetarian_dish: Pepperjack Mac 'n' Cheese (on this week's hot bar list; may rotate off by Sep 26)

food.notes: Sat 4-10 PM (closed Sun).

food.vegetarian_dish: Royal Butter Masala with paneer (vegetarian leaf icon) - $20

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, near 78°F — stay for the afternoon events on the lawn.
alternatives.rain: Swap for the AORTIA art-relaxation session at Eno Arts Mill (10 AM–1 PM) and the Outlander exhibit indoors.

alternatives.rain: Stay in for Karaoke Night with Orange Community Players at Eno River Brewing.

practical_notes: Check the festival page for Ayr Mount parking and shuttle details before you go.
Buy festival tickets on the event page ahead of time.
Leave Raleigh by about 7:15 AM to reach the market near its 8 AM opening.

itineraries.title: Durham Market-to-Oktoberfest Saturday

itineraries.title: Downtown Raleigh: Oktoberfest and Gov't Mule at Red Hat
itineraries.theme: Black history walk, street Oktoberfest, then a big outdoor show
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Raleigh — park once and walk
itineraries.cost_range: Free to roughly $100+ per person (concert tickets not listed; see Red Hat)
itineraries.overview: Walk the Black history of downtown Raleigh from the Pope House Museum, then join NC Oktoberfest on Fayetteville Street for the afternoon. The night belongs to Gov't Mule and Ziggy Marley at Red Hat Amphitheater, with a late Jerry Garcia–themed afterparty at Kings for anyone still standing.

itineraries.title: Carrboro Music Festival Sunday
itineraries.theme: A free town-wide music festival on every corner of downtown Carrboro
itineraries.drive_time: About 40 min from Raleigh; 20 min from Durham
itineraries.cost_range: Free festival; about $20–$50 per person for food
itineraries.overview: The Carrboro Music Festival fills downtown with free sets all afternoon and evening. Start with brunch music at Weaver Street Market, walk the Main Street stages from 1 PM, and duck into Cat's Cradle for the hip-hop showcase.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, high near 80°F — bring sunscreen and water.

practical_notes: Expect crowds on Main St; arriving by bus or bike is easiest.
Want Saturday too? The kickoff open mic is 2 PM at Town Commons and the kickoff show is 8 PM at the Cat's Cradle Back Room.

itineraries.title: Tuesday Canes Opener at Lenovo Center
itineraries.theme: An NC State-area afternoon before the Hurricanes' 5 PM game against Florida
itineraries.drive_time: West Raleigh — 10 min between NC State and Lenovo Center
itineraries.overview: The Hurricanes host the Panthers at 5 PM on Tuesday. Take the morning at JC Raulston Arboretum or the Gregg Museum, eat an early lunch off Hillsborough St, and head to Lenovo Center with time to spare. Pizza at Trophy after the final horn.

food.vegetarian_dish: Saag Paneer (GF) - $18.99
